cmd.audit.long:
Launches an opencode session with the auditor agent to perform an audit.

Available audit types:
  security       Vulnerabilities, injections, secret management, dependencies
  performance    Memory leaks, N+1, rendering, bundle size, lazy loading
  architecture   Coupling, cohesion, patterns, layers, technical debt
  accessibility  WCAG, ARIA, contrast, keyboard navigation, screen readers
  ecodesign      Carbon footprint, resource weight, unnecessary requests, green patterns
  observability  Logs, traces, metrics, alerting, correlation, SLI/SLO
  privacy        GDPR, personal data, consent, retention, minimization
cmd.audit.prompt: Perform a %s audit of the project. Focus: %s.
cmd.audit.short: Run a code audit via opencode

cmd.completion.long:
To load autocompletion:

Bash:
  $ source <(oh completion bash)
  # To load for every session:
  $ oh completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/oh

Zsh:
  $ source <(oh completion zsh)
  # To load for every session:
  $ oh completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_oh"

Fish:
  $ oh completion fish | source
  # To load for every session:
  $ oh completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/oh.fish

PowerShell:
  PS> oh completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

cmd.init.preamble:
Welcome to oh — OpenHub CLI

To configure the hub, you will need:

LLM Provider (one required)
  • Amazon Bedrock : configured AWS profile (~/.aws/credentials) or bearer token
  • Anthropic      : API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
  • OpenRouter     : API key (OPENROUTER_API_KEY)
  • GitHub Copilot : active Copilot access (gh auth)

MCP Servers (optional)
  • Figma          : personal access token (scope file:read)
  • GitLab         : personal access token (scope api)
  • Google Slides  : OAuth access token

Everything can be configured later:
  oh provider setup — provider credentials
  oh mcp setup      — MCP tokens

cmd.init.long:
Launches a configuration wizard to initialize the hub and register the first project.

The wizard configures:
  - Interface language and opencode version
  - Project (name, path, language, tracker)
  - MCP servers to enable (Figma, GitLab, Google Slides)
  - Ticket tracker (bd) if available
  - Automatically deploys agents and skills to the project

oh is the monolithic CLI for OpenHub.
It orchestrates opencode sessions, manages projects, deploys agents/skills/MCP,

cmd.team.init.long:
Launch an interactive wizard to configure team collaboration.

The wizard configures 4 adaptive steps:
  1. Global config (takeover, sessions)
  2. Identity (team registration)
  3. Mattermost notifications (optional)
  4. Team policies (automated conventions)

The team-state repo must be created beforehand on GitLab/GitHub.
If the repo is already configured, only relevant steps are offered.

generate a takeover brief before claiming it.
